performance_acceptance: NOT_ESTABLISHED; diagnostic measurements depend on this machine and headless execution and do not establish rendered, networked, or release capacity.

runs.contact_semantics: contact_queries is the authoritative hex exposure-query counter; processed_clashes counts emitted real hex_clash outcomes. It is not an invented narrowphase-call estimate.

event_accounting.semantics: Each exact trim row reports its assigned pending event ID and whether it entered a successfully packet-packed host envelope before removal; first_envelope_tick is -1 when it did not. Envelope inclusion does not prove socket delivery, remote receipt, or presentation.

runs.input_semantics: Pressed intents and held Rapid input-ticks are reported separately. Held cooldown, recovery, Flux, and capacity nonadmission may be silent and is exposed by the admitted count rather than fabricated as a refusal.
runs.instrumentation_scope: Event accounting duplicates encoder and bounded-queue classification only after timing samples. Its dictionaries and exact trim records remain allocated during the run, so static/process memory figures include this diagnostic overhead and are not directly comparable to receipts without event-accounting-v1.
runs.measurement_scope: Timing covers real SimWorld.step; host timing adds production event retention and every-other-tick envelope capture/packing. Additive by-type and exact-ID event accounting runs after those timing samples. Cleanup is excluded from quantiles but included in terminal counters and hashes.
